evals.name: cold-start-from-raw-footage
evals.prompt: I've got two long videos in ~/Downloads from a night at my old school — 20260918_194531.mp4 and 20260918_211316.mp4. Make something watchable out of them, around 90 seconds. Export it to ~/Downloads/eval0-<yourname>.mp4 when you're done.
evals.expected_output: A ~90s exported vertical mp4 built from selected moments across both sources, plus evidence the agent surveyed rather than guessed.
assertions: Export is portrait 1080x1920, not 1920x1080 (the rotation flag on the sources was detected rather than trusting raw ffprobe width/height)
Export duration is between 75 and 115 seconds (the user asked for about 90)
The cut draws material from BOTH source files, not just one
The export has an audio track carried over from the source
The agent surveyed the footage before cutting (sampled frames and/or windowed transcription) rather than picking ranges blind

evals.name: text-layer-titles-and-captions
evals.prompt: Take ~/Downloads/20260918_211316.mp4 (14 min, me and my friends walking round our old school at night) and cut it to about 90 seconds. I want a title on each new scene and captions on everything we say. Export to ~/Downloads/eval1-<yourname>.mp4.
evals.expected_output: A ~90s cut with per-scene titles and dense captions, titles visually distinct from captions, nothing wrapping to three lines.
assertions: Export duration is between 75 and 115 seconds
At least 3 distinct scene titles appear across the cut
Captions cover the majority of the speech in the cut, not just a few selected lines
Titles are visually distinct from captions in BOTH typeface and colour
Titles and captions live on separate timeline tracks so both can show at once
No rendered text block wraps onto three or more lines
The agent surfaced uncertain words/names for the user to confirm before exporting

evals.name: repair-after-manual-deletion
evals.prompt: I was editing the Palmier project 'eval-repair-fixture' and deleted a couple of clips I didn't like. Can you tidy up whatever that left behind?
evals.expected_output: Orphaned titles/captions removed, and the tail fade re-applied to the new final clip.
assertions: All four orphaned text clips are removed: title 'the rock wall', caption 'this goes down to the rock wall', title 'closing time', caption "hey, what's the plan?"
A fade-out is restored on the new final video clip (fadeOutFrames > 0)
The three still-valid title/caption pairs are left intact
The three surviving video clips are not retimed, retrimmed or removed
The gap left in the video track by the deleted middle clip is either closed or explicitly raised with the user
